title: Streamlined natural sentence answers
body:
- Redesigned in-game question responses into unified, direct natural-language sentences (e.g. "✓ Yes — The country has direct coastline access to the sea." or "✗ No — The country does not border Germany.") combining the visual answer indicator with clear interpretation.
- Removed redundant separate status badges and eliminated duplicate "Yes, " / "No, " prefixes in answer descriptions.
- Detailed geographic references and specific sea names remain securely kept for post-game deduction reviews.
- Your saved game progress, daily streaks, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
